description: This PHP source file defines the Download controller for the account section of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It manages user authentication, listing downloadable files with pagination, and handling file downloads, including serving files with appropriate headers and logging download reports.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Controller class handling user download listings and file downloads within the account section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of downloadable files, including pagination and breadcrumb setup.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles the download process by serving the file with appropriate headers and logging the download.
